title: 18107 - 18107/P1699/005785
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Steering Wheel Elektroniği (J527) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Steering Wheel Elektroniği (J527)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Cruise Control System Switch (E45)
technicalNotes: When retrofitting Cruise Control make sure to have the Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri done right. If you activate the Cruise Control prior to properly retrofitting the Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and the Cruise Control Lever/Stalk you will also find this Fault Code being stored.
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
